composition: One-card-at-a-time swipe rail for a product's variants. Design model §8.2 — the next card stays 10–18% visible so the rail announces itself, native scroll-snap does the swiping, and no variant is reduced to a badge at the top of the page.

source.page: Straboard product archetype, built to the owner's design model v1.1 and the supplied content brief
